buyerFaq.q: Can I share this guide with my recruiting team?
buyerFaq.a: Yes, within your organization. The Personal license covers your HR and hiring team. Do not post the PDF publicly or resell it. Department-wide redistribution outside your company requires permission — email info@promptanatomy.help.

buyerFaq.q: Can I use it for more than one job opening?
buyerFaq.a: Yes. Reuse prompts and scorecards for every role you hire. Update competencies and rubrics per role family.

buyerFaq.q: What if I lose the download email?
buyerFaq.a: Email info@promptanatomy.help from your purchase address and we will resend a fresh signed link. Links expire after 7 days; we re-issue on request.

buyerFaq.a: Reply to your Stripe receipt within 14 days for a no-questions refund. We revoke the download link after approval.
